reference_photo.title: 197-213 Yangshupu Rd. Shanghai
reference_photo.author: Livelikerw
reference_photo.recorded_description: ​上海市优秀历史建筑：杨树浦路197-213号

source_image_observations.coordinates: Review coordinates are on a 960 by 638 scale of the full 4912 by 3264 source.
source_image_observations.left_and_middle_observed: Two neighboring red brick archivolts spring from stepped red blocks. The upper sashes each have a vertical and two inclined fan bars. They sit above pale rectangular double-leaf frames.
source_image_observations.nearby_distinction: The third opening has a later rectangular insert. The adjoining corner bay has another larger arch.
